a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا
p: Inna-lladhīna āmanū wa ʿamilu-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti sa-yajʿalu lahumu-r-Raḥmānu wuddā.
m: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
